SELECT n.notice_sn, n.notice_title, n.notice_cn, n.important_yn, n.view_cnt, n.use_yn, n.register_id, u.user_nm AS register_nm, TO_CHAR(n.regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regist_dt, n.updusr_id, TO_CHAR(n.updt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updt_dt FROM tb_notice n LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_user u ON n.register_id = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_sn = #{noticeSn} AND n.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_notice ( notice_title, notice_cn, important_yn, view_cnt, use_yn, register_id, regist_dt ) VALUES ( #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeCn}, #{importantYn}, 0, 'Y', #{registerId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_notice SET notice_title = #{noticeTitle}, notice_cn = #{noticeCn}, important_yn = #{importantYn}, updusr_id = #{updusrId}, updt_dt = NOW() WHERE notice_sn = #{noticeSn} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE tb_notice SET use_yn = 'N', updt_dt = NOW() WHERE notice_sn = #{noticeSn} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE tb_notice SET view_cnt = COALESCE(view_cnt, 0) + 1 WHERE notice_sn = #{noticeSn} AND use_yn = 'Y'
